segments.content:
Chapter 194: 0191 Forcing a Legend to go Free-to-Play (Bonus chapter for Alliance Leader "My Little Smurf Account") The third day of closed beta testing.

Noon, in the dormitory.

Already hooked, Li Jun yelled at his roommate next to him: "The story behind the idiom 'a single word is worth a thousand gold pieces,' which ancient Chinese work is it related to? a) 'Huainanzi,' b) 'Strategies of the Warring States,' c) 'Nanhua Jing,' d) 'Lüshi Chunqiu.' Hurry up! Hurry up! I only have 40 seconds."

"What the hell are you screaming about? I'm looking it up!"

His roommate Zhang Peng quickly typed on Baidu, then said: "Lüshi Chunqiu."

Li Jun shouted again: "The idiom 'the whip is too short to reach,' which part of the horse is the whip unable to hit? a) the back, b) the rump, c) the belly... Damn it, it must be the rump, no need to search... I'm screwed, I picked the wrong one!"

Zhang Peng was speechless: "Dude, what's your hurry? I was already searching on Baidu."

Li Jun slammed the table in anger: "Fuck you, I wasn't even this serious in high school. I actually have to answer questions while playing a game!"

"You could choose not to answer," Xiang Weijie said, gloating.

The leveling speed in "Lord of the Throne" wasn't as insane as the later "Zhengtu." It took about 12 hours to reach level 20.

Sixty percent of the required experience points came from killing monsters, and forty percent from completing quests.

It couldn't be any faster, otherwise it would feel like playing on a private server.

This was designed based on the current gaming environment.

Upon reaching level 20, you could go to the examiner in the Royal City for a daily quiz bowl.

Answering half of the 10 questions correctly would grant an experience reward. The more questions answered correctly, the greater the reward. Answering all of them correctly would also reward "Culture Points," which could be accumulated to exchange for rare skill books.

"What are you doing?" Li Jun, who had only answered 7 questions correctly, turned to look at Xiang Weijie.

Xiang Weijie said: "Topping up."

Zhang Peng was surprised: "Why are you topping up for a free game?"

"The higher the level, the slower the leveling, and I'm not enjoying it," Xiang Weijie said. "Topping up 5 yuan gets you a first-time top-up gift pack. Besides other gifts, there's also a seven-day Moonlight Box effect, giving a 10% bonus to quest experience. The basic monthly VIP package gives a 10% bonus to monster-killing experience, plus exclusive daily VIP quests."

Zhang Peng, who even had to dip into his tuition to buy and sell computers, couldn't understand this mindset at all: "You're paying 30 yuan for a monthly VIP just for that little bit of extra experience?"

"There's more, it gives other stuff too. In a bit, look at the top of my head, there'll be a super cool VIP icon," Xiang Weijie said smugly. "This little bit of money is nothing. When I used to play private 'Legend of Mir' servers, buying a single piece of equipment would cost several hundred yuan."

A little while later, looking at Xiang Weijie's VIP aura and the little pony he got from topping up, Li Jun couldn't help but ask: "How do you top up?"

Xiang Weijie said: "You can't find physical cards for sale right now. You either buy a Yunwang digital card, use Youke's U-Pay, or use UnionPay e-payment. UnionPay is a real pain to use, sometimes it gets so frustrating you want to smash your computer."

Li Jun pulled out 100 yuan: "Help me top up 100 yuan. I'm gonna be a high-level VIP! Your basic VIP is nothing."

"Sure, Brother Jun. 60 yuan is enough for the high-level monthly VIP, you don't need 100," Xiang Weijie said with a smile.

Li Jun instantly felt like a big shot: "I don't have much, but I've got money! Top up the whole thing, I'll use it slowly."

The other guys in the dorm looked at each other, utterly stunned.

They were all free-to-play players.

Zhang Peng said sourly: "You can get the little pony from quests later on. I don't think it's necessary to pay for it."

Xiang Weijie laughed: "By the time you guys get your little ponies from quests, I'll be able to raid dungeons for those divine steeds."

"Exactly, paying money definitely makes you awesome!" Li Jun was already feeling the joy of a paying player, as satisfying as slam-dunking in front of a pretty girl.

"Let's go, let's raid a dungeon."

"I still have to do my farming quest."

"I have to do my fishing quest."

Li Jun urged: "What dungeon? Hurry up and help me top up 100 yuan!"

A few minutes later, the 100 yuan top-up was successful.

Looking at the remaining 40 Yuanbao from his high-level monthly VIP, Li Jun first went to the shop to buy keys.

In the past three days, he had accumulated a lot of treasure chests from killing monsters.

Wooden, iron, and bronze chests could all be opened with corresponding keys purchased with in-game silver. No real money top-up was needed.

Now he had three silver chests and one gold chest left.

"Come and watch me open chests!" Li Jun blew on his hands and rubbed them together.

Xiang Weijie thought to himself: Moron, those low-level treasure chests will only give you low-level equipment at best. It'll be useless once your character levels up.

His roommates quickly gathered around.

"Haha, blue equipment from the first chest... Huh, why is it level 10 equipment? Its stats are worse than what I'm wearing." Li Jun was extremely bummed.

"Hahahaha!"

Everyone burst into laughter at once.

Li Jun said unhappily: "I'll open the gold chest first... A purple strength gem, can be socketed into equipment below level 30. I think they sell them in the shop, let me check... Hahaha, I've struck it rich. The price of this kind of gem is much higher than a gold key!"

Xiang Weijie muttered: "What damn good luck."

Feeling like his luck was off the charts, Li Jun ran to the paid lottery draw.

He got one free draw every day, and it never felt like enough. Now he could finally do a ten-draw with money!

"Stop, stop, stop, stop!"

"Quick, see what it is!"

"There's purple, there's purple!"

His buddies were very excited.

Xiang Weijie laughed heartily: "There is indeed purple. 10 pieces of purple bait. Go fishing with it, maybe you'll catch a big golden fish. Hmm, then go learn cooking and make a supreme health-restoring feast."

Li Jun was annoyed: "What are you laughing at? I also got silver and materials, and a piece of level 28 blue equipment."

He did two more ten-draws, and the things he got made his roommates laugh their heads off.

"No laughing!"

Li Jun, flustered and exasperated, pointed at his inventory and said: "There's a level 20 purple belt, and a level 15 purple weapon. I can use them both. My luck is great!"

Xiang Weijie said: "Those are the guaranteed purple items from the ten-draw. Even with the worst luck, you'll still get them. We're guaranteed to get both of those if we run the level 25 dungeon a few more times."

"Damn it!"

Looking at his remaining 2 Yuanbao, Li Jun said, extremely displeased: "If you're so good, you do it."

"I'll do it then." Xiang Weijie topped up 100 yuan, specifically for the lottery.

The first ten-draw, a guaranteed garbage purple item.

The second ten-draw, a guaranteed garbage purple item.

On the sixth ten-draw, a golden light flashed.

"Golden, golden!"

"Whoa, quick, see what it is!"

His buddies were shouting and hollering.

Xiang Weijie quickly moved his mouse over it: Chixiao Forging Blueprint (Level 40). To forge one of the ten legendary swords renowned through the ages, you must use heavenly materials and enlist a Grandmaster-level swordsmith. Required materials as follows...

This time it was Li Jun's turn to burst out laughing: "Wow, one of the ten legendary swords... its forging blueprint. Let me see, these materials of yours won't be easy to find. You need five types of golden materials, and a bunch of purple materials too."

Xiang Weijie gritted his teeth: "Boss Tao is so damn devious, trying to trick me out of my money in every way possible!"

Despite saying that, Xiang Weijie was actually quite happy.

During the closed beta, the maximum level was only 40. If he could gather all those materials and forge a level 40 orange weapon, he would definitely become famous on this server.

"Damn it, I need to level up. The officials said that once we hit level 30, a lot of new gameplay features will be unlocked!" Xiang Weijie was full of ambition.

Shanda, Shidou.

Chen Tianqiao called a meeting with several game managers.

They were: Li Yu, in charge of "Legend of Mir"; Qu Haibing, in charge of "The World of Legend"; and Zhang Xiangdong, in charge of "MapleStory" and "Crazyracing Kartrider."

In addition, there was the "Emperor of Workers," Tang Jun.

Chen Tianqiao said: "Shi Yuzhu started promoting his 'Zhengtu' as a free-to-play game back in August. He's been promoting it for over two months, but unexpectedly, another free-to-play game launched first. And 'Yulgang,' which announced a few days ago that its concurrent user count broke 300,000!"

Qu Haibing said: "We don't need to worry about 'Yulgang.' Although its online player count continues to rise, the game's reputation is getting worse. The game itself has too many technical loopholes, even the communication protocol isn't encrypted, and data packets can be directly tampered with. The client-side anti-cheat only relies on process detection, so a cheat program can bypass it just by changing its name. Of those 300,000 concurrent users, I'm afraid half of them are probably AFK botters."

"That's right," Li Yu said. "Even if 'Yulgang's' online player count reaches 1 million, it's bound to die a spectacular death sooner or later."

This was the Korean developer's problem, full of technical loopholes, making it impossible to prevent cheats.

The Chinese publisher wanted to fix it, but the Korean side was uncooperative.

Because "Yulgang" was originally a pay-to-play game, changed to free-to-play by the Chinese publisher. The Korean side insisted that those technical loopholes were caused by the Chinese publisher's unauthorized modifications to the game.

"Of course I'm not afraid of 'Yulgang'," Chen Tianqiao said. "But this 'Lord of the Throne' has already opened four servers, and even on non-holiday evenings, they are all full. They'll definitely have to open new servers this weekend. It's easy for their peak concurrent user count to exceed 50,000."

"'Yulgang' is randomly selling items, and the game balance is getting worse. I had someone top up and play 'Lord of the Throne,' and they are very cautious about selling items. Even in the lottery, they only give out finished purple equipment below the current level, which players can get by running dungeons a few more times. As for orange equipment, you can only draw the forging blueprints, which in turn encourages players to collect materials."

"The daily check-in and lottery systems in it are very impressive. I estimate many games will imitate them. That guy named Tao Chenggang is simply a genius. No wonder he dared to sell off his family assets to make a game."

"Also, that Shi Yuzhu, promoting an unfinished game for months in advance, is clearly very confident in his own game. By the middle of next month, we'll have 'Yulgang,' 'Lord of the Throne,' and 'Zhengtu' all online as free-to-play games. This will greatly affect our player numbers!"

Zhang Xiangdong suggested: "Let's also make a free-to-play game. I'm in charge of 'Crazyracing Kartrider' and 'MapleStory,' so I know a thing or two about selling items."

Tang Jun shook his head and said: "We can't make a rash change. In the short term, it could lead to a sharp decline in profits. We are a listed company, and we must be cautious in everything we do."

"Has the number of online players for 'Legend of Mir' been dropping significantly lately?" Chen Tianqiao asked.

Li Yu said, bracing himself: "The versions we've updated are all old maps stitched together with old monsters. The players are very dissatisfied with this, and many are playing on private servers in retaliation."

Chen Tianqiao said: "Let's open two free new servers for 'Legend of Mir' and see how it goes. Have the technical department follow up."

"Legend of Mir" was also going free-to-play, but only on the new servers.
